summary: VNET Group filed a Form 6-K announcing the resignation of CFO Qiyu Wang for personal reasons, effective April 30, 2026, unrelated to any disagreement or company operations. The company had previously appointed Peter Zhihua Zhang as SVP of Operational Finance in February 2026 to oversee financial operations and serve as principal accounting officer. No financial terms, board recommendation, or advisor are mentioned. This is an abrupt senior management departure; watch for potential interim CFO appointment and any subsequent strategic or operational shifts.
